newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy completes four offshore wells.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy completes four offshore wells.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said four recently drilled wells in the Gulf of Mexico have added an initial 1,427 barrels of liquids and 12.8 million cubic feet of natural gas per day to the company's daily net production.
As a result, Forcenergy's current net daily production is about 11,000 barrels of liquids and 112.0 million cubic feet of natural gas, the company said.

Forcenergy said it's recently announced South Marsh Island Block 11 discovery well, the SMI 11 No. 54, is completed in two zones and is currently testing at 884 barrels of oil and 4.6 million cubic feet of natural gas daily.
The well is producing higher liquids volumes and lower natural gas volumes than projected since a zone previously assumed to be natural gas was completed as an oil well, the company explained.

Forcenergy said it plans to drill an additional well to accelerate production. At least six additional wells are planned during 1997 on the company's 100 percent owned South Marsh Island 6/10/11/19/285 complex including several high potential exploration wells.

Forcenergy said it completed two additional development wells and one exploratory well in the north half of its 100 percent owned South Marsh Island Block 106 field. The three added some 543 bareels of oil and 8.1 million cubic feet of natural gas to daily net production.
The company said plans to drill at least three high potential exploration wells in the field during 1997.
